meta.what: How shop prices (Rs) are said in Hindi (hi) and Marathi (mr): formal Devanagari, hundreds style (1100-1999), colloquial fractional forms (सवा/डेढ़/ढाई/पौने/साढ़े; सव्वा/दीड/अडीच/पावणे/साडे), and romanized spellings.

fields.formal: standard spelled-out number; primary=true is built from the primary spelling of each word; other entries are what a source produced when it differs (spelling variants)
fields.hundreds_style: 1100-1999 said as N hundred (hi ग्यारह सौ पचास, mr अकराशे पन्नास)
fields.colloquial: fraction-prefix forms; rule shows the arithmetic; spacing_variants = same words, other spacing
fields.library_mixed_unverified: after the independent check only 3 Hindi entries remain: colloquial forms spelled with छः (पौने/सवा/साढ़े छः सौ); the thousands + fractional-hundreds forms were removed as doubtful (see check_report.json)
fields.roman: romanization built from the most-attested spelling of each word; roman_variants swap in the next attested spellings; per-spelling sources and counts are in words[lang][word].roman
fields.wiki_count: exact occurrences of the phrase (or word) in Dakshina's filtered Wikipedia training text (hi 1.07M / mr 0.36M sentences); 0 does not mean wrong, Wikipedia rarely spells out prices
fields.check.value_parser: value recomputed by this build's own word-arithmetic parser
fields.check.gpu_sankhya: value from the gpu-sankhya 0.8.0 parser (npm): match-verified = whole phrase parsed to the price and every token is in its lexicon
fields.words[lang][w].roman[].sources: dakshina-lexicon (count = annotator attestations in hi/mr.translit.sampled.*.tsv), dakshina-sentences (count = aligned tokens in romanized Wikipedia sentences), gpu-sankhya (hi_latn pack list), composed / rule (this work, only when nothing is attested)
fields.check.independent_parser: value recomputed by the independent checker's own lexicon and arithmetic (scripts/check_price_words.py), for the text and every spacing variant
fields.check.nemo_itn: NVIDIA NeMo inverse text normalization (nemo_text_processing 1.2.0, CardinalFst for hi/mr): true = parsed to the price; null = the NeMo grammar cannot parse this form (spelling not in its lexicon, no Marathi fraction words, bare सवा सौ etc.); false never occurs
